recommended_option: rebuild 50% of the lost monthly spend
headline: Sunset Hardware's spend is falling across seven categories at once — this needs a relationship conversation, not a product fix.
rationale: Eight lines across seven different categories all declined together (Fasteners, Power Tools, Consumables, Electrical, Precision Hardware, Safety, Diagnostic) — no single category explains it. Monthly spend has fallen from ₹173,763 to ₹135,167, a broad-based ₹38,597/month drop that a discount or mix fix won't touch.
why_not_more_aggressive: Rebuilding 100% (₹38,597/month, restoring health) assumes a full win-back is achievable from a conversation alone; nothing in the data supports that scale of reversal.
why_not_less_aggressive: Rebuilding only 33% (₹12,737/month) leaves ₹25,860/month still short and undersells an account with 22.8 months of history and no manager disruption.
expected_result: Recovering 50% of lost spend brings back ₹19,298/month in revenue and ₹5,726/month in margin (₹68,710 over 12 months), but still leaves the account ₹19,299/month short of healthy.
what_to_do: Book a face-to-face review with Sunset Hardware's buyer to discuss the broad pullback, not a single product.
Walk through the specific declines: FF-Stainless Fastener Pack down from Rs 15,378.78 to Rs 2,441.10/month, PT-Angle Grinder 900W down from Rs 14,302.71 to Rs 4,852.53/month.
Ask directly why CN-Abrasive Discs 25pk fell from Rs 13,682.17 to Rs 2,795.02/month and EA-MCB 32A from Rs 9,417.74 to Rs 5,228.47/month.
Set a joint target to rebuild spend toward Rs 19,298/month recovered revenue over the next two quarters.
Escalate to a senior sponsor call if the buyer cannot explain the across-the-board decline.
talking_points: Your monthly spend with us has dropped from Rs 173,763 to Rs 135,167 across seven categories, not one.
Fastener Pack orders alone fell from Rs 15,378.78 to Rs 2,441.10 a month.
We want to understand what changed before this becomes permanent.
check_before_acting: Whether the buyer or procurement contact at Sunset Hardware has changed
Whether Sunset Hardware has slowed as a business or shifted sourcing to another supplier
Whether any of these lines were discontinued by the customer themselves rather than lost to a competitor
what_is_left_over: Even at 50% recovery, Rs 19,299/month of the decline remains unaddressed; only full rebuild (Rs 38,597/month) restores the account to healthy.
downside_if_wrong: If the cause is a lost competitive bid rather than relationship drift, a review conversation alone will not recover any of the Rs 38,597/month.
how_we_will_know_it_worked: Monthly revenue rises from Rs 135,167 toward Rs 154,465 (50% rebuild) — check at 3 months
Margin recovers toward Rs 5,726/month — check at 6 months
Fastener Pack and Angle Grinder order volumes show renewed movement — check at next quarterly review
